title: 第三章 从今天起开挂第四章 打死不练全国第九套广播练体操
content_zh:
晚上七点多。
王腾一家人才最终坐在一起吃晚饭。
“你爸车都到半路了，公司又有点事，一来一回耽误了一个多小时，就不能吃完饭再回去。”
李秀梅给王腾夹着菜，抱怨道。
王腾在房间里查了一个多小时的资料，倒是把吃饭给忘了，所幸他爸正好有事回来的迟了。
“事情紧急，只能先回去处理一下。”
王胜国无奈道。
“咱们别理你爸，他就一门心思放在他那个破公司上面。”
李秀梅朝着王盛国翻了个白眼。
王腾心中笑了笑。
其实，在高中时期，王腾和他爸的关系有点僵硬，王盛国望子成龙，对他自然严格了点，但是王腾在高中时期总归是有点叛逆，也很不学无术，与他爸的冲突就越来越深。
不过现在想想，王腾觉得过去的自己，一些行为实在幼稚的可笑。
饭桌上，王腾和王盛国都显得比较沉默，李秀梅忙着给王腾夹菜，跟父子俩拉着家常。
王腾很享受这种氛围。
王盛国跟王腾聊了几句，主要是询问学习上的情况。
王腾中规中矩的回答，没有像以前那样满满的中二气息，动不动就摔筷子闹脾气。
王盛国有些诧异，觉得他今天有些不一样，但是也没多想。
他吃完了饭，又急冲冲的出门去了。
作为一家大公司的掌舵人，他一天的事情其实是很多的，他每天几乎都只睡四五个小时。
王腾和李秀梅打了声招呼，也出了门，然后直奔【极星武馆】。

一辆黄色跑车在夜晚的街道上疾行，轰鸣声引人注目，现在的车都采用原力作为能源，早就淘汰了汽油，更加环保和便宜。
先驱者们不但从星武大陆带回了修炼方法，更带回了各种各样的原力文明产物。
原力符文就是其中一种。
地球的科技结合原力文明，诞生了原力科技，汽车使用原力，电脑和手机也使用了最新研发的原力符文芯片与电池，运行更快，续航更久……
半个小时后，王腾驱车停在了武馆门前。
按照他找到的资料显示，极星武馆是华夏区域武馆中的三巨头之一，武馆馆主是12星战将级武者，战力能排进华夏前五。
即便在全球范围，也是前二十的强者。
正式武者，1到9星为战兵级，10星为准战将级，11星下位战将级，12中位战将级，13星上位战将级……
极星武馆馆主的实力可见一斑！
极星武馆总部在夏都，不过在华夏各大城市都有分馆，武者成员众多，强者如云。
极星武馆的东海分馆位于海边，在黑夜中宛如一头巨兽匍匐在那里，占地面积堪比一座高校。
武馆正门足以让五六辆车并行通过，很是大气。
正门中间立着一块巨石，巨石上面极星武馆东海分馆几个龙飞凤舞的烫金大字极为醒目。
content_en:
It's around 7pm.
Only then did Wang Teng's family finally sit down to have dinner together.
"Your dad's car is already halfway there, and there's something else going on at the company. It's delayed him for more than an hour, so he can't go back after dinner."
Li Xiumei complained while holding dishes for Wang Teng.
Wang Teng checked information in the room for more than an hour, but he forgot to eat. Fortunately, his father happened to be late when he came back.
"The matter is urgent, so we can only go back and deal with it first."
Wang Shengguo said helplessly.
"Let's ignore your dad. He's only focused on his crappy company."
Li Xiumei rolled her eyes at Wang Shengguo.
Wang Teng smiled in his heart.
In fact, in high school, the relationship between Wang Teng and his father was a bit stiff. Wang Shengguo expected his son to succeed, so he was naturally a bit strict with him. However, Wang Teng was always a bit rebellious and uneducated in high school, and the conflict with his father became more and more serious.
But thinking about it now, Wang Teng felt that some of his past behaviors were really childish and ridiculous.
At the dinner table, both Wang Teng and Wang Shengguo seemed relatively silent. Li Xiumei was busy picking up vegetables for Wang Teng and making household chores with the father and son.
Wang Teng enjoyed this atmosphere very much.
Wang Shengguo chatted with Wang Teng for a few words, mainly asking about his studies.
Wang Teng gave a decent answer, but he didn't have the full second-level aura as before, and he would throw his chopsticks and lose his temper at every turn.
Wang Shengguo was a little surprised and felt that something was different about him today, but he didn't think much about it.
After he finished his meal, he hurried out again.
As the head of a large company, he actually has a lot to do in a day, and he almost only sleeps four or five hours a day.
Wang Teng and Li Xiumei said hello and went out, then went straight to [Pole Star Martial Arts Gym].
A yellow sports car speeds down the street at night, its roar attracting attention. Today's cars all use the Force as energy, and gasoline has long been eliminated, making it more environmentally friendly and cheaper.
The pioneers not only brought back cultivation methods from the Star Martial Continent, but also brought back various products of Force civilization.
Force runes are one of them.
The technology of the earth combined with the civilization of the Force gave birth to Force technology. Cars use the Force, and computers and mobile phones also use the newly developed Force rune chips and batteries, which run faster and last longer...
Half an hour later, Wang Teng drove to the door of the martial arts gym.
According to the information he found, Jiexing Martial Arts School is one of the three giants among the martial arts schools in China. The owner of the martial arts gym is a 12-star general-level warrior, and his combat power ranks among the top five in China.
Even globally, they are among the top 20 players.
Formal warriors, 1 to 9 stars are warriors, 10 stars are associate warriors, 11 stars are low warriors, 12 stars are mid-level warriors, 13 stars are high warriors...
The strength of the master of Ji Xing Martial Arts School is evident!
The Ji Xing Martial Arts Gym is headquartered in Xia Capital, but has branches in major cities in China. It has many martial arts members and is as strong as a cloud.
The Donghai branch of Ji Xing Martial Arts School is located on the seaside. In the dark night, it looks like a giant beast crawling there, covering an area comparable to that of a university.
The main entrance of the martial arts hall is large enough for five or six cars to pass through in parallel, which is very grand.
There is a huge stone standing in the middle of the main entrance. On the huge stone, there are very eye-catching gilded characters of Jixing Martial Arts School Donghai Branch.
